relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily V member 1 (TRPV1) was identified using capsaicin, a pungent compound that is present in red pepper.

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: The activation of TRPV1 induces an influx of calcium ions into cells and causes excitation of sensory neurons, associating with thermal sensing, sweating and pain.

key_findings: Review of development of an 11C-radiolabeled PET tracer to visualize TRPV1 in vivo.
